about_the_game:
Bell & Hoof: The Silent Journey is a relaxing walking simulator that invites you to explore a quiet, forgotten world through the eyes of a humble cow.

Journey through stylized farms, forests, and ruined chapels as you uncover echoes of the past and follow a trail of bells to guide your way. Without combat or time pressure, you are free to wander at your own pace and soak in the atmosphere.

Key Features:

  • 🌾 Explore abandoned fields, forests, and snowy paths

  • 🔔 Follow the sound of bells to discover memories

  • 🎶 Enjoy a peaceful soundtrack and ambient sounds

  • 🎮 Partial controller support for cozy play

  • 🏆 Unlock Steam achievements as you progress

  • 🐄 Experience the journey of a lone farm animal in a stylized world

Perfect for players looking for an emotional, reflective adventure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3200U or Intel Core i3 4th Gen
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (AMD Radeon Vega 3 or Intel UHD Graphics 620)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard, mouse, or controller recommended for best experience
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800U or Intel Core i5 10th Gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Graphics or NVIDIA GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound
  • Additional Notes: Controller recommended for a cozy gameplay experience

short_description: Embark on a peaceful journey as a humble cow through abandoned farms and snowy landscapes. A tranquil walking simulator about exploration, reflection, and finding meaning in a quiet, forgotten world.
